release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.5.1 — Parent AI Analytics Suite, Strict Class Isolation & Skeuomorphic Safe Vault Keypad:
• Parent Study & Wellbeing Reporting Suite: Interactive period selection (Today, 7 Days, 7 Weeks), verified screen reduction and question accuracy analytics, official study dossier generation, and one-tap export & share via WhatsApp or Email.
• AI Cognitive Behavioral Diagnosis: Synthesizes real activity interception logs, digital wellbeing data, and study sessions to deliver executive diagnoses, behavioral trends, and actionable parent recommendations.
• Strict Class Question Isolation: Hardcoded question bank filtering guaranteeing students exclusively receive questions curated for their exact class level (Classes 6 to 12).
• Skeuomorphic Parent PIN Override: Redesigned Titanium & Obsidian 3D safe vault keypad with chamfered keys, illuminated capsule LEDs, biometric authentication, and tactile drop shadows across native and React Native overlays.
• 30,000 Verified Rationalized NCERT Questions: Full offline question database bundled inside the APK.
